operations.T: [METHOD] delete [NAME] delete template [PATH] templates template id [PARAMS] id template [SCHEMA] success
[METHOD] delete [NAME] delete workspace [PATH] workspaces workspace id [PARAMS] id workspace [SCHEMA] success

operations.description: Returns a list of templates available for the authenticated workspace
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] templates [PATH] templates [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] list of template templates
[METHOD] get [NAME] template [PATH] templates template id [PARAMS] id template [SCHEMA] component config definition template
[METHOD] get [NAME] workspace [PATH] workspaces workspace id [PARAMS] id workspace [SCHEMA] workspace

operations.description: Creates a new template. If template configuration is not specified in the request body then an empty template is created. Template is placed to the workspace specified in authentication params. Template configuration must be sent in the request body.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] create template [PATH] templates [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] component config definition new template

operations.description: Allows to merge multiples template with data and returns base64 encoded document or public URL to a document. NB! When the public URL option is used, the document is stored for 30 days and automatically deleted.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] merge templates [PATH] templates output [PARAMS] format name output [SCHEMA] batch data document

operations.description: Creates a copy of a template to the workspace specified in authentication parameters.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] copy template [PATH] templates template id copy [PARAMS] id name template [SCHEMA] component config definition template

operations.description: Returns an unique URL which you can use to redirect your user to the editor from your application or use the generated URL as iframe source to show the editor within your application.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] editor url [PATH] templates template id editor [PARAMS] id language template [SCHEMA] editor url

operations.description: Merges template with data and returns base64 encoded document or a public URL to a document. You can send json encoded data in request body or a public URL to your json file as the data parameter. NB! When the public URL option is used, the document is stored for 30 days and automatically deleted.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] merge template [PATH] templates template id output [PARAMS] format id name output template [SCHEMA] data document

operations.description: Updates template configuration. The template configuration for pages and layout must be complete as the entire configuration is replaced and not merged.
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME] update template [PATH] templates template id [PARAMS] id template [SCHEMA] component config definition new template
